==Description==
The '''Duck Hunt Event''' was the tenth event added to Tower Defense Simulator. This event had a season pass, which required {{Eggs|Eggs}} to reach higher ranks.

This event started on 17th of April 2022 and ended on 28th of May 2022. On 23rd of April 2022, two new skins were added to the season pass.

==Hunting Season Pass==
[[File:HuntingSeason.png|center|500px|thumb]]

You could obtain {{Eggs|Eggs}} from playing on [[D00M's Revenge]]. You could not get {{Eggs|Eggs}} by playing regular matches. The amount of {{Eggs|Eggs}} for each wave is as follows:

::{{Eggs|250 Eggs}} x (Waves/20)^1.75 (+{{Eggs|100 Eggs}} for triumph)

Losing on Wave ??? or on Wave 🦆 (Duck emoji) is treated as a loss on Wave 20.

In total, it would have taken {{Eggs|13,175 Eggs}} or {{Robux|2,030}} to complete the '''Hunting Season Pass'''.

==Trivia==
*There are multiple scrapped enemies that were meant to be added as part of the '''Duck Hunt Event''' or appeared in promotional material, but were never added to the event. These enemies are:
**A duck with red hat and red shoes, which can be seen on the '''Duck Hunt Event''' thumbnail.
***This duck has a very similar appearance to the [[Cool Ducky (D00M's Revenge)]], except that it does not have a skateboard.
***Two more variants of this duck could be seen on a [https://twitter.com/paradoxum_games/status/1511735482022916100 tweet] made by Paradoxum Games. These were likely not meant to be unique enemies, but instead recolored versions of the duck, made to recreate the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/among-drip Among Drip] meme.
**A duck with a blue propeller hat and a lollipop, which can be seen on the '''Duck Hunt Event''' thumbnail.
**Lead Ducky, which would have a steel helmet and its wings would be covered with metal armor. It was not added as it was not necessary.
***This would have been the only [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy to appear in the event.
**Roller Ducky, which would be a duck which would ride a blue wooden roller board. It was not added as it was not necessary.
**Penguin, which would look similar to [[P3NGU (D00M's Revenge)|P3NGU]], but without the metal armor. It was not added as it was not necessary.
*This, alongside the [[Metaverse Champions Event]] are the only events that do not award you an exclusive tower upon triumph.
*The objectives that appeared in this event were the first appearance of the [[Quest]] UI.
*Before the 19th of April 2022, the seventh rank was cheaper to buy with {{Robux|Robux}} than the sixth rank, since the seventh rank used to cost {{Robux|250}}.
**After the 19th of April 2022, the price was increased to {{Robux|320}}.
*All of the skins in the '''Hunting Season Pass''' would end up becoming skins for the [[Ducky Crate]].
